insert.title: V-Bar Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at the highest position with a V-bar and hold it with an overhand grip.
2. Pin your elbows to your sides.
3. Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
4. Return slowly to the start.

insert.title: Alternating Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and your elbows at your sides.
2. Exhale as you curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder without swinging your torso.
3. Lower slowly, then curl the other arm, and keep alternating.

insert.title: Straight-Bar Bicep Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a low cable and hold a straight bar with an underhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
2. Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower slowly with the cable under tension.

insert.title: Single-Arm Overhand Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at the highest position with a single handle and hold it with an overhand grip.
2. Pin your elbow against your side.
3. Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Incline Treadmill Walk (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the treadmill to a moderate incline, start the belt at an easy walking speed and step on.
2. Stand tall with your chest up, swinging your arms naturally, and let go of the handrails.
3. Walk at a pace where you can still breathe steadily, taking full strides.
4. Lower the incline and speed in the last minute to cool down before stepping off.

insert.title: Neutral-Grip Rear Delt Fly (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the machine so the handles are at shoulder height and sit chest against the pad.
2. Grip the neutral handles with a slight elbow bend.
3. Sweep your arms back and out until your shoulder blades squeeze.
4. Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch.

insert.title: Seated Shoulder Press (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Place a bench under the Smith bar and sit with your back supported.
2. Unrack the bar and hold it just above shoulder height with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
3. Lower the bar to about chin level, then press it up until your arms are straight.
4. Exhale on the press and rack the bar when finished.

insert.title: Straight-Bar Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at a low position with a straight bar, then face away from the stack and hold the bar overhead.
2. Stand in a split stance with your elbows pointing forward.
3. Extend your arms overhead until they are straight.
4. Bend your elbows slowly to return.

insert.title: Lying Chest Press (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie back on the machine with the handles at chest height and your feet planted, adjusting the seat if needed.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

insert.title: Reverse Curl (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
2. Keep your elbows at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Curl the bar up until your forearms are close to vertical, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to straight arms.

insert.title: Face Pull (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a resistance band at upper-chest or face height and hold the ends with an overhand grip.
2. Step back until the band is taut, with arms straight and feet staggered.
3. Pull the ends toward your face, driving your elbows out and back.
4. Pause briefly, then return slowly without letting the band snap back.

insert.title: Seated Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
2. Keep your elbows at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl the weights toward your shoulders without turning your wrists, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Cross-Body Triceps Extension (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at head height and stand sideways, holding the handle with the far hand.
2. Tuck your upper arm against your side.
3. Press the handle across your body by straightening your elbow.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Bulgarian Split Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of one foot on it behind you.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down by bending your front knee until your thigh is near parallel.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Kneeling Leg Curl (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on the pad of the machine with your shin against the roller and your hands on the handles.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Curl your heel toward your glute, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly under control, then switch legs.

insert.title: Single-Arm Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell over your shoulder with a straight arm.
2. Keep your upper arm still.
3. Bend your elbow to lower the weight toward your head.
4. Extend your arm back up, exhaling. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Rope Hammer Preacher Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench in front of a low cable and hold a rope with your palms facing each other, upper arms flat on the pad.
2. Exhale as you curl the rope toward your shoulders without lifting your elbows off the pad.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

insert.title: Floor Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on the floor holding dumbbells over your chest with straight arms.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Kneeling Single-Arm Lat Pulldown (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a resistance band overhead and kneel facing it, holding one end with an overhand grip.
2. Brace your abs and lean back slightly.
3. Pull your elbow down toward your ribs against the band, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arm is extended, then finish your reps and switch arms.

insert.title: Neutral-Grip Bench Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and plant your feet.
3. Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest with your elbows tucked in.
4. Press them back up as you exhale.

insert.title: Seated Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with back support holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
2. Keep your elbows pointing forward.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Over-Bench Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel beside a bench with your forearm resting on it, palm up, holding a dumbbell with your wrist hanging off the edge.
2. Keep your forearm flat against the bench.
3. Curl the dumbbell up by bending your wrist, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly until you feel a stretch, then switch arms.

insert.title: Spider Curl (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging straight down.
2. Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
3. Exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Wrist Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a low pulley with a short bar, sit facing it and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up.
2. Let your wrists hang past your knees.
3. Curl your wrists up, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

insert.title: Underhand Lat Pulldown (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at the machine with your thighs under the pads and grab the bar or handles with an underhand grip.
2. Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
3. Pull the handles to your upper chest, driving your elbows down, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Neutral-Grip Incline Chest Press (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the incline press machine with your back flat and the neutral handles at chest height.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Press the handles forward and up until your arms are almost straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

insert.title: Wide-Grip Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Place your hands on the floor wider than shoulder-width and extend your body into a straight line.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
4. Press up as you exhale until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Incline Skullcrusher (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on an incline bench holding a barbell over your chest with straight arms.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
2. Exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders without lifting your elbows off the pad.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

insert.title: Kneeling Single-Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Attach a handle to a high pulley and kneel facing the stack, holding the handle in one hand.
2. Brace your abs and lean back slightly.
3. Pull your elbow down toward your ribs, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arm is extended, then finish your reps and switch arms.

insert.title: Hack Squat Calf Raise (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set up on the hack squat machine with the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the platform and your back against the pad.
2. Keep your knees straight and lower your heels for a deep stretch.
3. Exhale as you press up onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.

insert.title: EZ-Bar Reverse Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Attach an EZ bar to a low pulley and stand facing the stack, gripping the bar with palms down.
2. Keep your elbows at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Curl the bar up until your forearms are close to vertical, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to straight arms.

insert.title: Standing Chest Press (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the pulleys at chest height, stand facing away from the stack in a staggered stance and hold a handle in each hand.
2. Keep a slight forward lean and brace your abs.
3. Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly under control.

insert.title: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at the machine with your thighs under the pads and grab the handles with a wide overhand grip.
2. Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
3. Pull the handles to your upper chest, driving your elbows down, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Seated Neutral-Grip Shoulder Press (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Adjust the seat so the neutral handles sit at shoulder height and your back rests on the pad.
2. Grip the handles with your palms facing each other.
3. Press up until your arms are straight without locking out hard.
4. Lower slowly back to the start.

insert.title: Close-Grip Bench Press (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a flat bench under the Smith bar and lie back with your eyes under it.
2. Grip the bar slightly narrower than your shoulders and unrack.
3. Lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows close to your sides.
4. Press back up, exhaling, and rack the bar when finished.

insert.title: Single-Arm Low Row (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad and grab one handle with your arm extended.
2. Keep your shoulders down and your torso still.
3. Pull your elbow back past your torso, squeezing your shoulder blade, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arm is extended, then finish your reps and switch arms.

insert.title: Single-Arm Incline Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in your top hand.
2. Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
3. Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Incline Chest Fly (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set two pulleys low, sit on an incline bench between them, and hold a handle in each hand with your arms open and slightly bent.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Sweep your hands up and together in a wide arc over your upper chest, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to the stretch.

insert.title: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at the machine with your thighs secured and grab one handle with an overhand or neutral grip.
2. Keep your chest up and your torso still.
3. Pull your elbow down toward your ribs, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arm is extended, then finish your reps and switch arms.

insert.title: Sissy Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a support for balance.
2. Rise onto the balls of your feet and brace your abs.
3. Lean back and bend your knees, letting them travel forward while your hips stay extended.
4. Press back up using your thighs, exhaling.

insert.title: Seated Neutral-Grip Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with back support and hold dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing each other.
2. Brace your abs and keep your back against the pad.
3. Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to your shoulders.

insert.title: Seated Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
2. Keep your elbows at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl the weights toward your shoulders, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Over-Bench Wrist Extension (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel beside a bench with your forearm resting on it, palm down, holding a dumbbell with your wrist hanging off the edge.
2. Keep your forearm flat against the bench.
3. Raise the back of your hand toward the ceiling by bending your wrist, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly until you feel a stretch, then switch arms.

insert.title: Single-Leg Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie face down on the machine with one leg under the pad just above your heel and your hips pressed into the bench.
2. Grip the handles and brace your abs.
3. Curl the pad toward your glutes with one leg, exhaling as you pull.
4. Lower it slowly under control, then finish your reps and switch legs.

insert.title: Standing Crunch (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a high cable and hold the rope beside your head, hips slightly back.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you crunch your ribs down toward your pelvis, keeping your hips still.
3. Inhale and return slowly to upright with the cable still under tension.

insert.title: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from parallel handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended.
2. Brace your abs and pull your shoulders down and back.
3. Pull your elbows toward your ribs until your chin clears the handles, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended.

insert.title: Floor Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended above your chest with a slight elbow bend and palms facing in.
2. Brace your abs and plant your feet.
3. Open your arms to the sides until your upper arms touch the floor.
4. Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together as you exhale.

insert.title: Single-Arm Front Raise (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at the lowest height and stand facing away from it, holding the handle by your hip.
2. Keep a slight elbow bend and brace your abs.
3. Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Chest-Supported Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging down.
2. Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
3. Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back down without swinging.

insert.title: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your shoulders pulled down.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you lift both knees up and toward one side, twisting your hips slightly.
3. Lower with control, then alternate to the other side or finish all reps on one side first.

insert.title: High-to-Low Chest Fly (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band high behind you and hold one end in each hand, stepping forward into a staggered stance.
2. Start with your arms out wide and slightly bent, at about head height.
3. Sweep your hands down and together in front of your lower chest, exhaling.
4. Return slowly to the start under control.

insert.title: Single-Leg Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and one leg on the lever above your heel, with the thigh pad secured.
2. Grip the handles and brace your abs.
3. Curl your heel down and back, exhaling as you pull.
4. Return slowly until your leg is nearly straight, then finish your reps and switch legs.

insert.title: Skullcrusher (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar over your chest with straight arms.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Kneeling Torso Rotation (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on the machine with your torso against the pads and set your range of motion.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips still as you rotate your torso to one side.
3. Exhale as you turn, then return slowly under control and repeat to the other side.

insert.title: Seated Knee Raise Crunch (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the machine with your back against the pad, hold the handles and set your legs behind the roller.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you lift your knees up toward your chest while curling your torso forward.
3. Inhale and slowly return without letting the weight stack touch.

insert.title: Shrug (Trap Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand inside a trap bar and grip the handles, hinging to lift it.
2. Stand tall with your arms straight and shoulders back.
3. Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears, squeezing at the top.
4. Lower slowly and return the bar to the floor when finished.

insert.title: Close-Grip Bicep Curl (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip on the inner bends, hands close together.
2. Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower slowly without swinging.

insert.title: Rear Delt Row (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hinge forward with a flat back holding a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Let your arms hang beneath your shoulders.
3. Row the weights up with your elbows flared out to the sides, squeezing your rear shoulders.
4. Lower slowly back to the start.

insert.title: Hollow Body Hold
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
2. Press your lower back into the floor, then lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
3. Hold the shape with your abs tight and your ribs down, breathing steadily, and raise your legs higher if your lower back lifts.

insert.title: Seated Calf Raise (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a block or plate and rest a padded barbell across your thighs near your knees.
2. Lower your heels as far as you can for a stretch.
3. Exhale as you rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Lying Crunch (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie back on the machine and place your arms or the handles as the machine directs, with your hips on the pad.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your ribs toward your pelvis against the resistance.
3. Pause at the top, then inhale and return slowly without letting the weight rest.

insert.title: Decline Sit-Up (Plate)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and hold a weight plate against your chest.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your torso up to a seated position.
3. Inhale and lower back down slowly, keeping the plate tight to your chest.

insert.title: Single-Arm Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench with one upper arm flat on the pad, holding a dumbbell with an underhand grip.
2. Exhale as you curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder without lifting your elbow off the pad.
3. Lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight, and finish all reps before switching arms.

insert.title: Russian Twist (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your torso leaning back, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest tall.
3. Rotate your torso to one side, then the other, moving with control and exhaling as you turn.

insert.title: Wrist Extension (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a low pulley with a short bar, sit facing it and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms down.
2. Let your wrists hang past your knees.
3. Raise the backs of your hands, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

insert.title: Shoulder Press (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set two cable handles at the lowest height and stand between them, holding the handles at shoulder height.
2. Brace your abs and stand in a split stance.
3. Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.

insert.title: Wide Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a lat pulldown station with your thighs under the pads and grab the wide neutral-grip handles.
2. Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
3. Pull the handles to your upper chest, driving your elbows down, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Preacher Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench in front of a low cable with your upper arms flat on the pad and hold a bar with an underhand grip.
2. Exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders without lifting your elbows off the pad.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

insert.title: Side Bend (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand beside a low cable and hold the handle in the hand nearest the stack, feet hip-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and bend your torso away from the stack, keeping your hips still.
3. Return upright slowly, exhaling as you rise, and finish all reps before switching sides.

insert.title: Standing Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding an EZ bar overhead with a close grip.
2. Brace your abs and keep your elbows pointing forward.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Archer Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Start in a wide push-up position with your hands well beyond shoulder width and your body in a straight line.
2. Shift your weight toward one hand and bend that elbow to lower your chest toward it, keeping the other arm straight.
3. Press back up with the working arm as you exhale.
4. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

insert.title: Single-Leg 45-Degree Leg Press (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
2. Release the safeties and keep your hips down.
3. Lower the platform slowly until your knee is bent to about 90 degrees.
4. Press through your heel to extend your leg without locking out, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Start in a push-up position with your hands by your lower chest and fingers pointing back or out.
2. Lean your shoulders well past your hands and keep your body rigid.
3. Bend your elbows to lower your chest, keeping elbows close to your body.
4. Press back up and exhale at the top.

insert.title: Hammer Preacher Curl (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad and grip the neutral handles with your palms facing each other.
2. Exhale as you curl the handles toward your shoulders without lifting your elbows off the pad.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

insert.title: Incline Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells over your chest with straight arms.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Close-Grip Chin-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with an underhand grip, your hands close together, and your arms extended.
2. Brace your abs and pull your shoulders down and back.
3. Pull your elbows toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended.

insert.title: Standing Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding dumbbells at chest height with your palms facing you.
2. Brace your abs and keep your elbows in front of you.
3. Press the weights overhead while rotating your palms to face forward.
4. Reverse the rotation as you lower them back to your chest.

insert.title: Single-Arm Rear Delt Row (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at about chest height and stand sideways, holding the handle with the far hand.
2. Hinge slightly with a neutral spine.
3. Pull the handle across and back with your elbow flared out wide.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar on your upper back and rest the top of one foot on a bench behind you.
2. Unrack the bar and keep your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down by bending your front knee until your thigh is near parallel.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then rack the bar and switch legs.

insert.title: Single-Arm Leaning Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a support like a rack upright with one hand and lean away from it, a dumbbell in the other hand.
2. Let the dumbbell hang with a slight elbow bend.
3. Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Tuck Crunch
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your legs lifted and your knees bent, hands behind your head.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your shoulders up while pulling your knees in toward your chest.
3. Inhale and lower back down slowly under control.

insert.title: Glute Bridge (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with a dumbbell resting on your hips, held with both hands, knees bent and feet flat.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Press through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders, exhaling.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Incline Leg Raise
insert.instructions:
1. Lie back on an incline bench and grip the top behind your head, with your legs straight.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you raise your legs until they reach hip height or above.
3. Inhale and lower slowly, stopping before your lower back arches off the bench.

insert.title: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
insert.instructions:
1. Place your hands on a stable bar or bench and set your body in a straight incline.
2. Keep your elbows pointed forward and your abs braced.
3. Bend your elbows to lower your forehead toward your hands.
4. Extend your arms and push back up to the start.

insert.title: Shoulder Internal Rotation (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable handle at elbow height and stand sideways, holding it with the hand nearest the stack.
2. Tuck your elbow against your side at a right angle.
3. Rotate your forearm inward across your belly, keeping your elbow still.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Single-Arm Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side with a slight elbow bend.
2. Brace your abs and keep your shoulders down.
3. Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Drag Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a low cable and hold a straight bar with an underhand grip, elbows at your sides.
2. Brace your abs and pull the bar up along your torso by driving your elbows back.
3. Exhale as you reach the top, then lower slowly keeping the bar close to your body.

insert.title: Seated Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a block or plate and rest a dumbbell across your thighs near your knees.
2. Lower your heels as far as you can for a stretch.
3. Exhale as you rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Incline Skullcrusher (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on an incline bench holding an EZ bar over your chest with straight arms.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Seated Crunch (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit facing a high cable and hold the rope or handle beside your head, with your hips on the floor or a bench.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your ribs toward your pelvis.
3. Inhale and return slowly to upright, keeping tension on the cable.

insert.title: Finger Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell with your forearm resting on your thigh, palm up and wrist hanging over your knee.
2. Let the dumbbell roll down to your fingertips.
3. Curl it back into your palm by closing your fingers, then lift the wrist slightly.
4. Lower slowly, then switch arms.

insert.title: Lying Chest Fly (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set two pulleys low, lie on a flat bench between them and hold a handle in each hand with your arms open and slightly bent.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Bring your hands together above your chest in a wide arc, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to the stretch.

insert.title: Paused Bench Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinned back and feet planted.
2. Unrack the bar and lower it to your mid-chest with control.
3. Pause for a full second with the bar touching your chest, keeping your body tight.
4. Press up explosively as you exhale.

insert.title: Box Squat (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Place a box behind you at a height where your thighs end up parallel, and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and brace your abs.
3. Sit back and down until you lightly touch the box, keeping your chest up.
4. Press through your feet to stand, exhaling at the top.

insert.title: Upright Row (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar at thigh height and stand holding it with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Unrack and brace your abs.
3. Pull the bar up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
4. Lower it slowly and rack the bar when finished.

insert.title: Rope Lat Pulldown (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Attach a rope to a high pulley, sit with your thighs under the pads and grip the rope ends with your palms facing in.
2. Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
3. Pull the rope to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and spreading the ends apart, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Shoulder External Rotation (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable handle at elbow height and stand sideways, holding it with the hand farthest from the stack.
2. Tuck your elbow against your side at a right angle.
3. Rotate your forearm outward, keeping your elbow still.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Single-Arm Preacher Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench in front of a low cable with one upper arm flat on the pad, holding the handle with an underhand grip.
2. Exhale as you curl the handle toward your shoulder without lifting your elbow off the pad.
3. Lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight, and finish all reps before switching arms.

insert.title: Bent-Over Row (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at the lowest height and hold a bar or handle, hinging forward with a flat back.
2. Start with your arms extended and the cable taut.
3. Row the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your back.
4. Return slowly to the start.

insert.title: Seated Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with back support holding an EZ bar overhead with a close grip.
2. Keep your elbows pointing forward.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Row (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at chest height and kneel on the knee farther from the stack, holding the handle.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
3. Row the handle to your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Rear Delt Row (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a low cable station with a handle in each hand or a rope, arms extended.
2. Hinge slightly forward with a neutral spine.
3. Row with your elbows flared out wide to chest height, squeezing your rear shoulders.
4. Return slowly to the start.

insert.title: Single-Arm Seated Row (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a cable row station with feet braced and hold a single handle.
2. Sit tall and keep your torso still.
3. Row the handle to your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Low-Bar Back Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on your upper back below the traps, grip it wide and step back from the rack with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Pull your shoulder blades together and brace your abs.
3. Take a breath and squat down until your thighs are parallel, keeping your torso leaned forward.
4. Drive up through your whole foot as you exhale.

insert.title: Split Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand in a split stance with one foot a long stride in front of the other.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Lateral Lunge (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Step out wide to one side, push your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
3. Keep your chest up and your lunging foot flat.
4. Push off the bent leg to return to the center, exhaling, then switch sides.

insert.title: Low-to-High Chest Fly (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band low behind you and hold one end in each hand, stepping forward into a staggered stance.
2. Start with your arms low and slightly bent, hands out wide.
3. Sweep your hands up and together in front of your upper chest, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to the start with control.

insert.title: Behind-the-Back Shrug (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding a barbell behind your thighs with an overhand grip.
2. Keep your chest up and your arms straight.
3. Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears, squeezing at the top.
4. Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

insert.title: Kneeling Sissy Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on a pad with your thighs upright and your feet hooked behind you or anchored.
2. Brace your abs and keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
3. Lean back as your hips stay forward, lowering until you feel your quads stretch.
4. Pull yourself back up with your thighs, exhaling.

insert.title: Close-Grip Bicep Curl (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands closer than shoulder-width.
2. Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower slowly without swinging.

insert.title: Front Squat (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold two dumbbells at your shoulders with your elbows forward and your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Decline Reverse Crunch
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench and grip the top of it behind your head, with your knees bent above your hips.
2. Exhale and curl your pelvis up, lifting your hips toward your ribs rather than swinging your legs.
3. Inhale and lower your hips back down slowly until your lower back touches the bench.

insert.title: Wide-Grip Bicep Curl (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width.
2. Keep your elbows at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower slowly without swinging.

insert.title: Plank (Plate)
insert.instructions:
1. Set up in a forearm plank and have a partner place a weight plate on your upper back.
2. Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body stays in one straight line.
3. Hold the position while breathing steadily and stop when your hips begin to sag.

insert.title: Single-Arm Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
2. Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
3. Press the weight overhead until your arm is straight, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Hanging Knees to Elbows
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your shoulders pulled down.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your knees up toward your elbows, tilting your pelvis back.
3. Pause at the top, then inhale and lower your legs slowly without swinging.

insert.title: Assisted Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Set the assist weight, kneel or stand on the platform and grab the neutral handles with your palms facing each other.
2. Brace your abs and pull your shoulders down and back.
3. Pull your elbows toward your ribs until your chin passes the handles, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully extended.

insert.title: Ab Coaster Crunch (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the pad height so your forearms rest on the pads with your knees on the sliding carriage, and brace your abs.
2. Exhale and drive your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis up, rounding your lower back slightly.
3. Pause at the top, then inhale and slowly slide back to the start without letting the weight stack touch down.

insert.title: Single-Leg Seated Calf Raise (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the machine with the ball of one foot on the platform and the pad resting on that thigh just above the knee.
2. Lower your heel as far as you can for a stretch.
3. Exhale as you rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly, and finish all reps before switching legs.

insert.title: Decline Sit-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the pads and your arms crossed on your chest.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
3. Inhale and lower back down slowly under control without dropping onto the bench.

insert.title: Lying Cross-Cable Lateral Raise (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at the lowest height and lie on your side on a bench so the handle crosses over your body.
2. Hold the handle with the top arm, elbow slightly bent.
3. Raise your arm out to the side and up until it reaches shoulder height.
4. Lower slowly under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Lying Bicep Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back on a bench or floor with your head toward a low cable and hold the bar overhead or straight above your chest.
2. Keep your upper arms still and exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

insert.title: Standing Leg Curl (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a resistance band low and loop the other end around one ankle, facing the anchor.
2. Stand tall, hold a support and keep your knees close together.
3. Curl your heel toward your glute, exhaling as you pull against the band.
4. Lower your foot slowly without swinging your hip, then switch legs.

insert.title: Single-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band low behind you, hold the end in one hand, and raise your arm overhead.
2. Step away to create tension and keep your upper arm near your ear.
3. Straighten your elbow to extend the band overhead.
4. Bend your elbow slowly to return. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Grip Squeeze (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at the grip machine with your hand on the handle and your elbow resting at your side.
2. Keep your wrist straight.
3. Squeeze the handle as hard as you can, exhaling.
4. Release slowly until your hand opens fully.

insert.title: Reverse Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad and hold an EZ bar with an overhand grip.
2. Keep your wrists straight and your elbows on the pad.
3. Curl the bar up as high as you can, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.

insert.title: Wide-Grip Upright Row (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip wider than your shoulders.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest tall.
3. Pull the bar up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
4. Lower it slowly to the start.

insert.title: Finger Curl (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench holding a barbell with your forearms resting on your thighs, palms up and wrists hanging over your knees.
2. Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
3. Curl the bar back into your palms by closing your fingers, then lift the wrists slightly.
4. Lower slowly and repeat.

insert.title: Hammer Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad, holding dumbbells with your palms facing each other.
2. Exhale as you curl the weights up toward your shoulders without lifting your elbows off the pad.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

insert.title: Donkey Calf Raise (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set up on the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad across your lower back, hips hinged forward.
2. Keep your knees straight and sink your heels down for a deep stretch.
3. Exhale as you rise up as high as you can onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Triceps Pushdown (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band high, hold the ends, and stand facing it with your elbows by your sides.
2. Pin your elbows to your ribs.
3. Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
4. Return slowly to the start.

insert.title: Pistol Squat (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a kettlebell at your chest and stand on one leg, with the other leg extended in front.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit your hips back and lower as far as you can control.
4. Press through your standing foot to rise, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Bicep Curl (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of a band with your feet hip-width apart and hold the ends with your palms facing forward.
2. Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl your hands toward your shoulders, then lower slowly against the band.

insert.title: Heels-Elevated Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Unrack a barbell on your upper back and stand with your heels on a low plate or wedge.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
4. Press through your feet to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Straight Bar Dip
insert.instructions:
1. Grip a straight bar at waist height, jump or press up to straight arms and lean forward slightly.
2. Brace your abs and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
3. Lower yourself until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, then pause.
4. Press up as you exhale until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Curved Treadmill Run (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Step onto the curved, unmotorized treadmill belt and stand tall with your arms ready to swing.
2. Lean slightly forward and drive the belt back with each stride, landing on the balls of your feet.
3. Run at a steady effort, since your own push sets the speed, and keep your breathing rhythmic.
4. Slow your stride gradually at the end and walk for a minute to cool down.

insert.title: Single-Arm Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hinge forward with a flat back and support yourself with one hand, holding a dumbbell in the other.
2. Let the dumbbell hang with a slight elbow bend.
3. Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height, squeezing your rear shoulder.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Front Lever
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull your shoulders down.
2. Raise your body until your torso and legs are horizontal, facing up, with your arms straight.
3. Squeeze your lats and glutes to keep your body in one straight line and breathe steadily.
4. Hold for the target time, then lower under control.

insert.title: Upright Row (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest tall.
3. Pull the bell up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
4. Lower it slowly to the start.

insert.title: Front Squat (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and rest it on your front shoulders with your elbows forward, feet slightly in front of the bar.
2. Unrack the bar and brace your abs.
3. Sit down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling, then rack the bar.

insert.title: Lying Face Pull (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head toward a low cable, holding a rope attachment.
2. Start with your arms straight and the cable taut.
3. Pull the rope toward your face, spreading the ends and driving your elbows out.
4. Return slowly to the start.

insert.title: Sumo Squat (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar on your upper back and step forward with a wide stance, toes turned out.
2. Pull your shoulder blades together and brace your abs.
3. Lower with control until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your whole foot to stand up as you exhale.

insert.title: Assisted Nordic Hamstring Curl (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band overhead, kneel on a pad with your ankles held and the band held at your chest.
2. Keep your body straight from head to knees.
3. Lower yourself forward as slowly as you can, using the band to help.
4. Pull back up with your hamstrings as you exhale.

insert.title: Incline Shrug (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells with straight arms.
2. Keep your head neutral.
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades up and back, shrugging toward your ears.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Incline Skullcrusher (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at the lowest height and lie back on an incline bench facing away from it, holding the handle.
2. Start with your arms extended above you.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back up, keeping your upper arms still.

insert.title: Seated Calf Raise (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Place a bench under the Smith bar and sit with the balls of your feet on a block, then set the bar across your thighs near your knees and unrack it.
2. Lower your heels as far as you can for a stretch.
3. Exhale as you rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly and rerack the bar when finished.

insert.title: Eccentric Dragon Flag
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head, then raise your body to a straight vertical line on your upper back and shoulders.
2. Brace your abs and glutes and keep your body rigid from shoulders to toes.
3. Lower your body slowly as one straight piece, stopping just above the bench before you lose your lower back position, then reset to the top.

insert.title: Crossover Lat Pulldown (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a lat pulldown station with your thighs under the pads and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
2. Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
3. Pull the bar down and across, bringing it to your upper chest and crossing one hand slightly in front of the other, exhaling.
4. Return the bar slowly until your arms are straight, switching the crossing hand each rep.

insert.title: Good Morning (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar on your upper back and stand with your feet slightly in front of the bar.
2. Brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing them back until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall as you exhale.

insert.title: Rear Delt Fly (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a band in both hands in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight, and stand tall.
2. Keep a slight bend in your elbows and shoulders down.
3. Pull your hands apart and back until your arms form a straight line.
4. Return slowly without letting the band snap.

insert.title: Deadlift (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
2. Hinge at the hips, grip the handle and keep your back flat.
3. Drive through your feet and push your hips forward to stand tall, exhaling.
4. Lower the kettlebell back to the floor by pushing your hips back.

insert.title: Lying Pullover (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a bench with your head toward a low pulley, holding a bar or rope behind your head with straight arms.
2. Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
3. Sweep the handle in an arc over your face to your thighs, exhaling.
4. Return slowly along the same arc until you feel your lats stretch.

insert.title: Double Overhead Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders with forearms vertical and feet hip-width apart.
2. Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
3. Press both bells overhead until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower them back to your shoulders slowly.

insert.title: Alternating Bench Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed over your chest, feet planted.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Lower one dumbbell to the side of your chest while the other stays locked out above you.
4. Press it back up as you exhale, then lower the other arm and keep alternating.

insert.title: 21s Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your elbows at your sides.
2. Do 7 reps from the bottom to halfway up, then 7 reps from halfway to the top.
3. Finish with 7 full-range reps, exhaling as you curl and lowering slowly without swinging.

insert.title: Pistol Squat to Box
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on one leg in front of a box with the other leg extended in front, arms forward.
2. Sit your hips back and lower under control until you touch the box.
3. Keep your chest up and your heel flat.
4. Press through your standing foot to rise, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Band-Assisted Chin-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Loop a resistance band over a pull-up bar and place one knee or foot in it, then grip the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
2. Brace your abs and pull your shoulders down.
3. Pull your elbows down until your chin clears the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully extended.

insert.title: Reverse Lunge (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar on your upper back and unrack it with your feet slightly in front of the bar.
2. Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
3. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
4. Press through your front foot to return to the start, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Upright Row (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest tall.
3. Pull the bar up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
4. Lower it slowly to the start.

insert.title: Neutral-Grip Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your upper chest, palms facing each other.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and plant your feet.
3. Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest with your elbows tucked in.
4. Press them back up as you exhale.

insert.title: Reverse Preacher Curl (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad and hold a barbell with an overhand grip.
2. Keep your wrists straight and your elbows resting on the pad.
3. Curl the bar up as high as you can, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.

insert.title: Decline Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench holding dumbbells over your chest with straight arms.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Split Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on your upper back and stand in a split stance with one foot a long stride in front.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Incline Close-Grip Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Place your hands close together on a raised surface and set your body in a straight line.
2. Keep your elbows close to your sides and your abs braced.
3. Lower your chest toward your hands.
4. Press back up to full arm extension.

insert.title: Seated Chest Press (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the pulleys at chest height, sit on a bench facing away from the stack and hold a handle in each hand.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

insert.title: Deficit Deadlift (Trap Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a low plate or platform inside a trap bar and grip the handles.
2. Brace your abs, keep your chest up and your back flat.
3. Drive through your feet to stand tall, exhaling.
4. Lower the bar slowly to the floor by pushing your hips back.

insert.title: Incline Front Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging at your sides.
2. Keep a slight elbow bend and your back against the pad.
3. Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
4. Lower them slowly with control.

insert.title: Band-Assisted Dip
insert.instructions:
1. Loop a band around the dip bars and place one knee in it.
2. Support yourself with straight arms and lean slightly forward.
3. Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
4. Press back up and exhale at the top.

insert.title: Abdominal Vacuum
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall or kneel on all fours, exhale fully and let all the air out of your lungs.
2. Without inhaling, pull your belly button up and in toward your spine as far as you comfortably can.
3. Hold the contraction for the target time, keeping your ribs down, then relax and breathe normally.

insert.title: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding an ab wheel on the floor in front of you with a slight hip hinge.
2. Brace your abs and keep your back flat as you roll the wheel forward in a controlled line.
3. Go as far as you can without your lower back sagging, then pull the wheel back toward your feet, exhaling on the way.

insert.title: Frog Crunch
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and your knees dropped out to the sides.
2. Place your hands behind your head and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl your shoulders up while pulling your knees toward your chest, then inhale and lower back slowly.

insert.title: Spider Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms hanging down.
2. Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
3. Exhale as you curl the weights toward your shoulders, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Front Squat (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Attach a bar or handles to a low pulley and hold them at your shoulders with your elbows forward, facing the stack.
2. Step back, brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Deficit Stiff-Leg Deadlift (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a low platform facing a low pulley, gripping the attached bar with an overhand grip.
2. Keep your knees slightly bent and brace your abs.
3. Hinge back and lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall as you exhale.

insert.title: Pinch Hold (Plate)
insert.instructions:
1. Pinch two weight plates together by the smooth sides, smooth faces out, with your fingers on one side and thumb on the other.
2. Stand tall with your arm at your side.
3. Hold the plates for as long as you can without letting them slip.
4. Lower them carefully, rest, then switch hands.

insert.title: Jump Squat (Trap Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand inside a trap bar holding the handles at your sides with a light load.
2. Squat down to quarter or half depth with your chest up.
3. Jump explosively, exhaling.
4. Land softly with your knees bent and reset before the next rep.

insert.title: Skullcrusher (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at the lowest height and lie on a bench with your head toward the stack, holding a bar or rope.
2. Start with your arms extended over your chest.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back up, keeping your upper arms still.

insert.title: Incline Close-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie back on an incline bench and unrack a barbell with a grip slightly narrower than your shoulders.
2. Keep your wrists straight and your elbows close to your sides.
3. Lower the bar to your upper chest.
4. Press it back up, exhaling, and rack it when finished.

insert.title: Decline Chest Fly (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set two pulleys at a high position, lie on a decline bench between them, and hold a handle in each hand with your arms open and slightly bent.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Sweep your hands down and together in a wide arc until they meet over your lower chest, exhaling.
4. Return slowly to the stretch with your elbows slightly bent.

insert.title: Wall Handstand
insert.instructions:
1. Place your hands on the floor about a hand's length from a wall and kick up until your heels rest against it.
2. Spread your fingers and push the floor away with your shoulders.
3. Squeeze your abs and glutes and keep your body in a straight line.
4. Hold for the target time, breathing steadily, then come down with control.

insert.title: Overhead Swing (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands by the horn.
2. Hinge at the hips and swing it back between your legs.
3. Drive your hips forward to swing the kettlebell up overhead, exhaling.
4. Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping a neutral spine.

insert.title: Pallof Press (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band at chest height and stand sideways to it, holding the band at your chest with both hands.
2. Brace your abs and press the band straight out in front of you while resisting the pull to rotate.
3. Hold for a moment, then bring your hands back to your chest and repeat before switching sides.

insert.title: Seated Tibialis Raise
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench or chair with your heels on the floor and your knees bent at 90 degrees.
2. Keep your heels planted and exhale as you pull your toes up toward your shins as far as you can.
3. Lower slowly until your feet are flat again.

insert.title: Wrist Curl (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, and hold a band under your foot or anchored low with the other end in your hand.
2. Let your wrist hang past your knee.
3. Curl your wrist up against the band, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly to a stretch, then switch arms.

insert.title: Tuck Jump
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms ready at your sides.
2. Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up as you jump explosively.
3. Pull your knees toward your chest at the peak of the jump.
4. Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees, then reset before the next rep.

insert.title: Shrug (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a resistance band and hold the ends at your sides.
2. Keep your arms straight and your chest tall.
3. Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears, squeezing at the top.
4. Lower slowly.

insert.title: Lying Leg Curl (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie face down with a band anchored in front and looped around your heels, hands under your head.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips down.
3. Curl your heels toward your glutes, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly under control.

insert.title: Single-Arm Overhead Curl (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band high overhead, stand facing it and hold the end in one hand with your arm extended out to the side at shoulder height.
2. Keep your upper arm still and your torso tall.
3. Exhale as you curl your hand toward your head, then return slowly, and finish all reps before switching arms.

insert.title: Sumo Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders, toes angled out, holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
2. Soften your knees and keep your back flat.
3. Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings and inner thighs.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and exhale at the top.

insert.title: Staggered-Stance Romanian Deadlift (Trap Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand inside a trap bar with one foot slightly behind the other, on the ball of the back foot, and hold the handles.
2. Keep your front knee slightly bent and your back flat.
3. Push your hips back and lower the bar along your front leg, feeling the hamstring stretch.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and exhale, then switch your stance for the next set.

insert.title: Overhead Press (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at shoulder height.
2. Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
3. Press the band overhead until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to your shoulders.

insert.title: Seated Good Morning (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with a barbell on your upper back and your feet flat, hip-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
3. Take a breath and hinge forward from your hips until your torso is near parallel to the floor.
4. Squeeze your glutes to sit back upright, exhaling.

insert.title: Push Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Dip a few inches at the knees, keeping your torso upright.
3. Drive up through your legs and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
4. Lower them slowly back to your shoulders and reset.

insert.title: Glute Bridge (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with a band across your hips and its ends anchored under your hands, knees bent and feet flat.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Press through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders, exhaling.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Thruster (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart, elbows slightly forward.
2. Take a breath, brace, and squat down as low as you comfortably can with your chest up.
3. Drive up through your heels and use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
4. Lower the weights back to your shoulders under control as you reset for the next rep.

insert.title: Chest-Supported Rear Delt Raise (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench and hold a light barbell with an overhand grip, arms hanging.
2. Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your neck neutral.
3. Raise the bar by pulling your elbows up and back, squeezing your rear shoulders at the top.
4. Lower the bar slowly, keeping the movement strict.

insert.title: Overhead Triceps Extension (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band low behind you, hold the end with both hands, and raise your arms overhead.
2. Step away from the anchor to create tension and keep your upper arms close to your ears.
3. Straighten your elbows to extend the band overhead.
4. Bend your elbows slowly to return.

insert.title: Landmine Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a barbell in a landmine, hold the free end with both hands at hip height and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing them back and lowering the bar along your legs.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall as you exhale.

insert.title: Wrist Extension (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your forearm on your thigh, palm down, and hold a band under your foot or anchored low with the other end in your hand.
2. Let your wrist hang past your knee.
3. Raise the back of your hand against the band, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly to a stretch, then switch arms.

insert.title: Single-Arm Swing (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
2. Hinge at the hips and swing it back between your legs.
3. Drive your hips forward to swing the kettlebell to chest height, exhaling.
4. Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping a neutral spine, then switch hands.

insert.title: Glute-Focused 45-Degree Back Extension (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the 45-degree back extension so the pad sits below your hips and your feet are locked in, arms crossed over your chest.
2. Round your upper back slightly and tuck your pelvis.
3. Lower with control, then raise your torso by squeezing your glutes, exhaling.
4. Stop when your body is in a straight line.

insert.title: Side-Lying Clamshell (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side with a band looped just above your knees and your knees bent.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips stacked.
3. Exhale as you open your top knee against the band without rolling back, then lower slowly and repeat.

insert.title: Banded Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Loop a band across your upper back and hold each end under your palms as you get into a push-up position.
2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
3. Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
4. Press up as you exhale, working against the band's tension until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Jumping Pull-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with an overhand grip, bending your knees slightly.
2. Jump up explosively while pulling your elbows down.
3. Bring your chin above the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself slowly for a few seconds until your arms are extended, then reset.

insert.title: Deficit Pike Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Place your hands on two raised platforms and set your hips high in an inverted V.
2. Keep your legs straight and head between your arms.
3. Bend your elbows and lower your head down between the platforms.
4. Press back up through your hands to the starting position.

insert.title: Front Squat (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold two kettlebells in the rack position at your shoulders with your elbows tucked in.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Lying Lateral Neck Flexion (Plate)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side on a bench with your head over the edge and hold a light plate against the side of your head.
2. Keep your shoulders still and your movement small.
3. Slowly lower your ear toward your shoulder.
4. Lift your head back up to level with controlled effort, then switch sides.

insert.title: Chest-Supported T Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench with light dumbbells hanging down.
2. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
3. Raise your arms out to the sides into a T shape.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: High Plank
insert.instructions:
1. Place your hands under your shoulders with your arms straight and your feet hip-width apart.
2. Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body forms one straight line from head to heels.
3. Hold the position, keeping your neck neutral and breathing steadily, until the time is up.

insert.title: Side Plank Hip Adduction
insert.instructions:
1. Set up in a side plank on your forearm with your top foot in front on the floor.
2. Brace your abs and lift your bottom leg up toward the top leg.
3. Lower it slowly with control, and finish all reps before switching sides.

insert.title: Plank Pull-Through (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set up in a high plank with a kettlebell on the floor beside one hand.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level as you reach under your body with the other hand and drag the kettlebell across.
3. Place it down on the opposite side, then repeat with the other hand.

insert.title: Deficit Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a low plate or platform holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step one leg back and off the platform and lower your back knee toward the floor.
3. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
4. Press through your front foot to return to the start, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Windmill (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a kettlebell overhead with one arm locked out and turn your feet slightly away from that side.
2. Push your hips back toward the weight side and slide your free hand down your leg, keeping your eyes on the kettlebell.
3. Lower as far as your hamstrings allow with a flat back, then drive your hips through to stand, exhaling as you rise.

insert.title: Romanian Deadlift (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell by the handle in front of your thighs.
2. Soften your knees, brace your abs and keep your back flat.
3. Push your hips back and lower the kettlebell along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and exhale at the top.

insert.title: Standing Torso Rotation (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band at chest height and stand sideways to it, holding the band with both hands in front of your chest.
2. Brace your abs and rotate your torso away from the anchor while your hips stay square.
3. Exhale as you turn, return slowly, and finish all reps before switching sides.

insert.title: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on one leg with a slight bend in your knee and your arms hanging in front of you.
2. Keep your hips square and your back flat.
3. Hinge forward at the hip as your free leg extends straight behind you until your torso is near parallel to the floor.
4. Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then repeat before switching sides.

insert.title: Deadlift (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand in the machine with your feet hip-width apart and grip the handles, keeping your back flat.
2. Brace your abs and pull your shoulders back.
3. Drive through your feet and push your hips forward to stand tall, exhaling.
4. Lower the weight slowly by pushing your hips back.

insert.title: Farmer's Carry (Trap Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand inside a loaded trap bar and grip the handles, hinging to set your back neutral.
2. Stand up tall with your shoulders back.
3. Walk a set distance with short, steady steps and your abs braced.
4. Lower the bar to the floor with control.

insert.title: Neutral-Grip Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Lower the dumbbells toward your lower chest with your elbows tucked in.
4. Press them back up as you exhale.

insert.title: Half-Kneeling Shoulder Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot forward, holding a kettlebell at shoulder height on the up-knee side.
2. Squeeze your glute on the kneeling leg and brace your abs.
3. Press the bell overhead until your arm is straight, exhaling.
4. Lower it slowly to your shoulder. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Rack Pull (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar at knee height and stand with your feet hip-width apart, gripping the bar just outside your legs.
2. Brace your abs, pull your shoulders back and keep your back flat.
3. Drive through your feet and push your hips forward to stand tall, exhaling.
4. Lower the bar slowly back to the rest position by pushing your hips back.

insert.title: Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell at your chest and rest the top of one foot on a bench behind you.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down by bending your front knee until your thigh is near parallel.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Two-Arm Landmine Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine and hold the other end at your chest with both hands.
2. Stand in a staggered stance and brace your abs.
3. Press the end up and forward until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower it slowly back to your chest.

insert.title: Paused Deadlift (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the bar over your midfoot, then hinge to grip the bar just outside your legs.
2. Tighten your lats, brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Drive your feet through the floor and pull the bar up to just below the knee, then pause for a second.
4. Continue to lockout as you exhale, then lower under control.

insert.title: Single-Arm Floor Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on the floor with one kettlebell held over your chest, bell resting against your forearm, and your knees bent.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso still.
3. Lower your upper arm until your elbow touches the floor.
4. Press back up as you exhale, then switch arms.

insert.title: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with a dumbbell on your hips, one foot planted and the other leg extended.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Press through your heel to lift your hips until your body is straight, exhaling.
4. Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower slowly and switch legs.

insert.title: Deficit Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Place your hands on two sturdy raised surfaces such as plates or blocks, shoulder-width apart, and extend into a push-up position.
2. Keep your body in a straight line and brace your abs.
3. Lower your chest below your hands, feeling a deep stretch.
4. Press up as you exhale until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Decline Skullcrusher (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench holding an EZ bar over your chest with straight arms.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Alternating Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed above your upper chest.
2. Pin your shoulder blades back and plant your feet.
3. Lower one dumbbell toward the side of your chest while the other stays extended.
4. Press it back up as you exhale, then switch sides and keep alternating.

insert.title: Overhead Sit-Up (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet anchored, holding a dumbbell straight above your chest with both hands.
2. Brace your abs and keep your arms locked in line with your ears as you curl up to sitting, exhaling.
3. Inhale and lower back down slowly with the dumbbell overhead.

insert.title: Skullcrusher (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band behind your head and lie on the floor or bench, holding the ends over your chest.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower your hands toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back up against the band.

insert.title: Kneeling Shoulder Press (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set two cable handles at the lowest height and kneel between them, gripping the handles at shoulder height.
2. Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
3. Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.

insert.title: Romanian Deadlift (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of a resistance band with your feet hip-width apart and hold the ends at your hips.
2. Keep your knees slightly bent and your back neutral.
3. Breathe in and push your hips straight back, sliding the band down your thighs.
4. Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips forward and stand tall, exhaling.

insert.title: Single-Leg Standing Calf Raise (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on one foot on a step with the heel hanging off, holding a cable handle at your side or a support for balance.
2. Lower your heel as far as you can for a stretch.
3. Exhale as you rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly, and finish all reps before switching legs.
