insert.title: Chest-Supported Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench with your upper arms pinned beside your torso.
2. Hold dumbbells with your elbows bent at a right angle.
3. Straighten your arms back, keeping your upper arms still.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Split Squat (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on the Smith rails at upper-chest height and unrack it across your upper back.
2. Step one foot forward and the other back so the front foot stays flat under the bar, then brace your abs.
3. Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel, keeping your torso upright.
4. Press through the front heel to stand and exhale near the top. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

insert.title: Seated Leg Extension (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench or box with a resistance band anchored behind you and looped around one ankle.
2. Hold the seat and keep your back upright.
3. Extend your knee until your leg is straight, exhaling and squeezing your quad.
4. Lower slowly under control, then finish your reps and switch legs.

insert.title: Reverse Hack Squat (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on the platform of a hack squat machine facing the pad, chest against it, with your feet in a comfortable stance and shoulders under the pads.
2. Release the safeties and brace your abs.
3. Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the platform.
4. Press through your whole foot to stand up as you exhale.

insert.title: Bench Reverse Hyperextension
insert.instructions:
1. Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge, holding the bench or its legs with your hands.
2. Let your legs hang straight down.
3. Raise your legs until they are in line with your torso, squeezing your glutes and exhaling.
4. Lower slowly without swinging.

insert.title: Tibialis Raise (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith machine bar at hip height and stand with your heels about a foot in front of the bar, back against it, holding the rails.
2. Lean back into the bar so your whole body tilts and your heels stay on the floor.
3. Pull your toes up toward your shins as far as you can, breathing out.
4. Lower your toes slowly to the floor and repeat.

insert.title: Single-Leg Landmine Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on one leg facing a landmine bar, holding the end of the bar with the opposite hand and a soft bend in your standing knee.
2. Keep your back flat and your hips square.
3. Hinge forward as your free leg reaches behind you and the bar lowers toward your shin.
4. Press through your standing foot to return upright, then switch sides.

insert.title: Incline Squeeze Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie back on an incline bench with two dumbbells pressed together above your upper chest.
2. Squeeze the dumbbells against each other throughout the set.
3. Lower them to your chest while keeping them pressed together.
4. Press them up as you exhale, still squeezing.

insert.title: Side-Lying Clamshell
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side with your knees bent and your feet together, head resting on your arm.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips stacked.
3. Exhale as you open your top knee toward the ceiling without rolling back, then lower slowly and repeat.

insert.title: Single-Arm Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell held above your chest, palm facing in, elbow slightly bent.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso from twisting.
3. Open your arm out to the side until you feel a stretch across your chest.
4. Bring it back up as you exhale, then switch arms.

insert.title: Chest-Supported High Row (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a cable at a low height and lie chest-down on an incline bench facing the stack, holding the handles.
2. Start with your arms extended.
3. Row with your elbows flared out wide toward your upper back.
4. Return slowly to the start.

insert.title: Underhand Seated Row (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad and grab the handles with your palms facing up.
2. Keep your shoulders down and your back flat.
3. Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arms are extended.

insert.title: Long-Arm Crunch
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms extended overhead.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your shoulder blades off the floor, keeping your arms in line with your ears.
3. Inhale and lower slowly back to the floor.

insert.title: Reverse Preacher Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a low pulley with a bar attached, sit at a preacher bench and hold the bar with an overhand grip, upper arms on the pad.
2. Keep your wrists straight.
3. Curl the bar up as high as you can, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.

insert.title: Decline Chest Press (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set two cable pulleys high, sit on a decline bench facing away, and hold a handle in each hand beside your chest.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Press the handles forward and down until your arms are extended, exhaling.
4. Return slowly to the start without letting the weight stack touch.

insert.title: Single-Arm Push Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder and stand with feet hip-width apart.
2. Dip a few inches at the knees, keeping your torso upright.
3. Drive up through your legs and press the bell overhead to a locked-out arm.
4. Lower it to your shoulder with control. Switch sides after your reps.

insert.title: Seated Hip Abduction (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench or chair with a band looped just above your knees and your feet flat.
2. Keep your torso tall and your back neutral.
3. Press your knees apart against the band, pause, then slowly bring them back together.

insert.title: Standing Neutral-Grip Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing each other.
2. Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
3. Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to your shoulders.

insert.title: Drag Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
2. Brace your abs and curl the weights up along your torso by pulling your elbows behind you.
3. Exhale as you reach the top, then lower slowly keeping the dumbbells close to your body.

insert.title: Half-Kneeling Chop (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band at a high point and kneel on the leg nearest the anchor, with the other foot flat in front.
2. Grip the band with both hands overhead and brace your abs.
3. Exhale and pull the band diagonally down across your body toward the outside hip, then return slowly, and repeat before switching sides.

insert.title: Hand-Release Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Lie face down with your hands flat under your shoulders and your body straight.
2. Lower your chest all the way to the floor and rest it there.
3. Lift your hands off the floor for a moment, then place them back.
4. Press up as you exhale to a straight-arm plank and repeat.

insert.title: Feet-Elevated Crunch Hold
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench and your knees bent at 90 degrees.
2. Exhale and curl your shoulder blades off the floor, reaching your hands toward your knees.
3. Hold the top position with your abs tight and your lower back pressed down, breathing steadily.

insert.title: Single-Leg Feet-Elevated Glute Bridge
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with one heel on a bench or step and the other leg extended in the air.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Press through your heel to lift your hips until your body is straight, exhaling.
4. Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower slowly and switch legs.

insert.title: Standing Leg Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it around one ankle, facing the stack.
2. Hold the frame for balance, stand tall and keep your thighs together.
3. Curl your heel toward your glute, exhaling as you pull.
4. Lower the weight slowly without letting your hip swing, then switch legs.

insert.title: Single-Arm Floor Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on the floor with one dumbbell held over your chest and your knees bent.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso still.
3. Lower your upper arm until your elbow touches the floor.
4. Press back up as you exhale, then switch arms.

insert.title: Body-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Start in a plank position on your hands with your body in a straight line.
2. Lower down onto your forearms one arm at a time, keeping your hips still.
3. Press back up onto your hands one arm at a time.
4. Keep your core braced and alternate which arm leads.

insert.title: Counterbalance Squat (Plate)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a weight plate out in front of your chest with straight arms and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your feet to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Tucked Hollow Body Hold
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your knees pulled in toward your chest and your arms by your sides.
2. Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders a few inches off the ground.
3. Hold the tucked shape with your abs braced and breathe steadily.

insert.title: Landmine Lateral Raise (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine or corner and stand sideways to it, holding the other end near your hip.
2. Brace your abs and keep a slight bend in your elbow.
3. Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Jumping Step-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a sturdy box with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Drop into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
3. Jump onto the box, landing softly on both feet.
4. Stand tall, step down and reset before the next rep.

insert.title: Reverse Crunch (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your head toward the stack and an ankle strap on a low pulley, holding a bench or the frame behind your head.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your hips up, bringing your knees toward your chest.
3. Inhale and lower your legs slowly against the cable.

insert.title: 45-Degree Back Extension (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Set up on a 45-degree bench with your hips on the pad and loop a band over your shoulders, anchored under the base.
2. Cross your arms or hold them at your chest and keep your neck neutral.
3. Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso under control.
4. Squeeze your glutes to raise your torso until your body is in a straight line, exhaling.

insert.title: Kneeling Side Crunch (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel beside a high cable and hold the rope or handle at your shoulder.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you bend your torso sideways, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
3. Inhale and return slowly upright, and finish all reps before switching sides.

insert.title: Single-Arm Chest Press (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the chest press machine with your back flat and one handle gripped at chest height.
2. Brace your abs and keep your shoulders square.
3. Press the handle forward until your arm is almost straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

insert.title: Deadlift (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand close to it with your feet hip-width apart, gripping the bar with an overhand grip.
2. Hinge, brace your abs and keep your spine neutral.
3. Drive through your feet to stand tall, pulling the bar along your legs, exhaling.
4. Lower the bar slowly back to the start.

insert.title: Upright Row (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest tall.
3. Pull your hands up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Heels-Elevated Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your heels on a low plate or wedge and your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold your arms in front of you and keep your chest up.
3. Sit down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
4. Press through your feet to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Concentration Curl (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your foot on one end of a band and hold the other end in the hand on the same side, with your elbow against your inner thigh.
2. Keep your chest up and your upper arm still.
3. Exhale as you curl your hand toward your shoulder, then lower slowly and finish all reps before switching arms.

insert.title: Single-Leg Hip Thrust (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit with your upper back against a bench and a barbell padded across your hips, one foot planted and the other leg lifted.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Drive through your heel until your torso is level, squeezing your glute and exhaling.
4. Lower slowly, then switch legs.

insert.title: Snatch-Grip Deadlift (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and grip the bar wide, in a snatch grip, with your hips low and back flat.
2. Tighten your lats and brace your abs.
3. Drive your feet through the floor and stand tall with the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower the bar under control, keeping it close to your legs.

insert.title: Back Extension (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set up on a back extension bench with your hips on the pad and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
2. Keep your neck neutral and your back flat.
3. Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso under control.
4. Squeeze your glutes to raise your torso until your body is in a straight line, exhaling.

insert.title: Single-Leg Hack Squat (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on the platform of the machine with your back against the pad and one foot in the middle.
2. Release the safeties and brace your abs.
3. Lower slowly until your knee is bent to about 90 degrees.
4. Press through your heel to stand without locking out, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Paused Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on an incline bench with your eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinned back and feet planted.
2. Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest with control.
3. Pause for a full second on your chest, keeping your body tight.
4. Press up as you exhale.

insert.title: Suitcase Deadlift (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with a kettlebell beside one foot, feet about hip-width apart.
2. Hinge at the hips, bend your knees slightly, and grab the handle with your back neutral.
3. Brace, then push through your heels to stand tall without leaning toward the weight side.
4. Lower the kettlebell back to the floor with control. Finish your reps, then switch hands.

insert.title: V-Up (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your legs straight and a dumbbell held overhead in both hands.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you lift your legs and torso together, reaching the dumbbell toward your toes.
3. Inhale and lower back down slowly under control.

insert.title: Standing Calf Raise Off Step
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step and your heels hanging off, holding a rail for balance.
2. Brace your abs and keep your knees straight.
3. Rise as high as you can on your toes and pause for a moment.
4. Lower slowly until your heels drop below the step, then repeat without bouncing.

insert.title: Broad Jump
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and swing your arms back as you bend your knees and hips.
2. Swing your arms forward and jump out as far as you can.
3. Land softly on both feet with your knees bent and your chest up.
4. Stand up, reset your stance and repeat.

insert.title: Strict Curl (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your back and glutes against a wall, holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
2. Keep your elbows at your sides and don't let your back leave the wall.
3. Exhale as you curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Concentration Triceps Extension (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the cable at the lowest height and kneel or sit facing the stack, holding the handle with one hand.
2. Brace your upper arm against your side or leg.
3. Extend your elbow to straighten the arm.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Standing Calf Raise (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of a band with the balls of your feet on a step or the floor and hold the ends at your shoulders.
2. Keep your knees straight and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you rise onto your toes against the band, pause, then lower your heels slowly.

insert.title: Suspension Rear Delt Fly
insert.instructions:
1. Hold the suspension handles with arms straight and lean back with your body in a straight line.
2. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
3. Pull your arms out to the sides until your hands are in line with your shoulders.
4. Return slowly under control.

insert.title: Snatch Pull (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand over the bar with a wide snatch grip and your hips low, back flat and shoulders over the bar.
2. Brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Drive your legs and extend your hips powerfully, pulling the bar up your body to chest height with your elbows high.
4. Lower it back to the floor with control.

insert.title: Front Rack Lunge (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold two dumbbells at your shoulders with your elbows forward and stand tall.
2. Step forward and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
3. Keep your chest up and your elbows lifted.
4. Push through your front foot to return to the start, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Deficit Handstand Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Kick up into a wall handstand with your hands on two raised platforms and your head able to dip below them.
2. Brace your abs and glutes and keep your body in a straight line.
3. Lower your head between the platforms with control until you reach a comfortable depth.
4. Press back up to full arm extension, exhaling on the way up.

insert.title: Standing Hip Adduction (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band low and loop it around your ankle on the side nearest the anchor, then stand tall holding a support.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Pull your working leg across in front of the other, then return slowly under control, and finish all reps before switching legs.

insert.title: Close-Stance Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it, then stand with your feet close together.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Split Squat (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a kettlebell at your chest or one in each hand and stand in a split stance.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Cossack Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet wide and your toes slightly turned out.
2. Shift your weight to one side and sit into that leg while the other leg stays straight with the toes up.
3. Keep your chest up and your heel down, lowering as far as your mobility allows.
4. Press through your bent leg to return to the center, then switch sides.

insert.title: Overhead Shrug (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a barbell overhead with your arms locked out at a snatch-width grip.
2. Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
3. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then pause.
4. Lower slowly while keeping your arms straight.

insert.title: Feet-Elevated Glute Bridge
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your heels on a bench or step and your knees bent, arms flat at your sides.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Press through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders, exhaling.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Knee Plank
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on a mat with your forearms on the floor and your elbows under your shoulders.
2. Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from your head to your knees.
3. Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes, and hold while breathing steadily.

insert.title: Single-Arm Shoulder Press (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Adjust the seat so one handle sits at shoulder height and your back rests on the pad.
2. Grip one handle and brace your abs.
3. Press up until your arm is straight without locking out hard.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: GHD Hip Extension (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the GHD so your hips sit just beyond the pad and your feet are locked in, then cross your arms over your chest.
2. Lower your torso toward the floor with a neutral spine.
3. Raise it back until your body is in a straight line, squeezing your glutes and exhaling.
4. Avoid arching past straight at the top.

insert.title: Block Pull (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a loaded barbell on blocks or pins at about knee height and stand with your shins close to the bar.
2. Grip the bar just outside your legs, hinge, tighten your lats and keep your spine neutral.
3. Take a breath and drive your feet into the floor to stand tall with the bar.
4. Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

insert.title: Single-Arm Bench Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell above your chest and your free hand on your stomach or out to the side.
2. Brace your abs and plant your feet so your body stays still.
3. Lower the dumbbell to the side of your chest.
4. Press it back up as you exhale, then finish your reps before switching arms.

insert.title: Shoulder External Rotation (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways, holding the end with the far hand.
2. Tuck your elbow against your side at a right angle.
3. Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly, keeping your elbow still.
4. Return slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Lateral Step-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Stand beside a box or bench, with the nearest foot on it.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Press through the lead foot to stand tall on the box, exhaling.
4. Lower your free foot slowly to the floor, finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Kneeling Glute Kickback (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a low pulley with an ankle strap, attach it to one ankle and kneel on all fours facing the stack.
2. Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
3. Kick your heel back and up, squeezing your glute and exhaling.
4. Return slowly, then switch legs.

insert.title: Single-Arm Pullover (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie across a bench with your upper back supported, holding a dumbbell in one hand over your chest with your arm nearly straight.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips low.
3. Take a breath and lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel your lat stretch.
4. Pull it back over your chest, exhaling, then switch arms.

insert.title: Seated Neck Extension (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Attach a head harness or strap to a low pulley and sit facing away from it, with the strap on the back of your head.
2. Sit tall and keep your torso still.
3. Tuck your chin slightly and slowly lower it toward your chest against the weight.
4. Extend your head back up under control and keep the range small.

insert.title: Assisted Nordic Hamstring Curl (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on a pad with your ankles secured and a cable handle held at your chest, set to assist you.
2. Keep your body straight from head to knees.
3. Lower yourself forward as slowly as you can.
4. Pull back up with your hamstrings as you exhale.

insert.title: Hanging Leg Raise (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with a cable ankle strap attached to the low pulley, and brace your abs.
2. Exhale and raise your legs up in front of you to hip height or higher, curling your pelvis up.
3. Lower slowly against the cable's pull without swinging your body.

insert.title: Forward Lunge (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a kettlebell at your chest or one in each hand and stand tall.
2. Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
3. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
4. Push through your front foot to return to the start, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Lateral Step-Up (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Place a box beside you inside the Smith machine, set the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
2. Put your nearest foot on the box and brace your abs.
3. Press through the lead foot to stand tall on the box, exhaling.
4. Lower your free foot slowly to the floor, finish your reps, then switch sides and rack the bar.

insert.title: Side Plank Hip Dip
insert.instructions:
1. Set up in a forearm side plank with your elbow under your shoulder and your body in one line.
2. Lower your hip toward the floor slowly while keeping your shoulders stacked.
3. Exhale as you drive your hip back up above the starting line, then repeat before switching sides.

insert.title: Seated Scapular Row (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a cable row station with feet braced and hold the handle with straight arms.
2. Sit tall with your chest up.
3. Pull your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
4. Release slowly to the start.

insert.title: Jefferson Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Straddle a barbell on the floor with one foot in front and one behind, and grip it with one hand in front and one behind.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Drive through your feet to stand up with the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower the bar slowly to the floor, then switch your stance.

insert.title: Side Bend (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side, feet hip-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and bend your torso sideways toward the weight, keeping your hips still.
3. Exhale as you lift back to upright, and finish all reps before switching hands.

insert.title: Rotational Throw (Medicine Ball)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand sideways to a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at your hip.
2. Brace your abs and rotate your hips and torso away from the wall to load.
3. Drive your hips through and throw the ball into the wall, then catch it and repeat before switching sides.

insert.title: Zercher Carry (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lift a barbell and rest it in the crooks of your elbows against your torso, standing tall.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up and your elbows tight.
3. Walk the set distance with short, controlled steps, then set the bar down carefully.

insert.title: Good Morning (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell at your chest with both hands.
2. Brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing them back until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall as you exhale.

insert.title: Standing Crunch (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band overhead, stand facing it and hold the band beside your head.
2. Brace your abs and hinge forward slightly as you crunch your ribs toward your pelvis, exhaling.
3. Inhale and return slowly to upright against the band's pull.

insert.title: Low Leg Raise Hold
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your hands under your hips and your legs straight.
2. Press your lower back into the floor and lift your legs until your heels are a few inches off the ground.
3. Hold them there with your abs braced and breathe steadily, lifting a little higher if your back arches.

insert.title: Step-Up (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a kettlebell in the goblet position at your chest, or one in each hand at your sides, and face a sturdy box.
2. Place one whole foot on the box and brace your abs.
3. Drive through the front heel to stand tall, exhaling at the top.
4. Step down slowly with control and repeat. Switch legs after your reps.

insert.title: Good Morning (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell at your chest by the horns.
2. Brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing them back until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall as you exhale.

insert.title: Box Squat (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Place a box under the Smith bar, set the bar below your collarbone and stand under it with your feet slightly forward.
2. Unrack the bar and brace your abs.
3. Sit back and down until you lightly touch the box, keeping your chest up.
4. Press through your feet to stand, exhaling at the top.

insert.title: Lateral Lunge (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Step out wide to one side, push your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
3. Keep your chest up and your lunging foot flat.
4. Push off the bent leg to return to the center, exhaling, then switch sides.

insert.title: Drag Curl (EZ Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip and your arms hanging down.
2. Brace your abs and pull the bar up along your torso by driving your elbows behind you.
3. Exhale at the top, then lower slowly keeping the bar close to your body.

insert.title: Human Flag
insert.instructions:
1. Grip a vertical pole with your top hand pushing and your bottom hand pulling, arms wide apart.
2. Brace your whole body and lift your legs sideways until your body is horizontal.
3. Hold the straight line as long as you can, then lower slowly with control.

insert.title: Single-Leg 45-Degree Back Extension (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the 45-degree back extension and lock in one foot, with the other leg hanging or tucked behind, arms crossed over your chest.
2. Keep a neutral spine.
3. Lower your torso with control, then raise it by squeezing your glute and exhaling.
4. Stop when your body is in a straight line, then switch legs.

insert.title: Side Plank Leg Raise
insert.instructions:
1. Set up in a side plank on your forearm with your body in one line.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you raise your top leg to hip height or a little higher.
3. Lower it slowly without dropping your hips, and finish all reps before switching sides.

insert.title: Single-Arm Overhead Carry (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and lock your elbow straight.
2. Keep your ribs down, abs braced, and your biceps near your ear.
3. Walk a set distance at a steady pace without leaning sideways.
4. Lower the weight with control, then repeat on the other side.

insert.title: Floor Back Extension (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie face down with a resistance band anchored under your feet or hips and looped around your upper back.
2. Keep your neck neutral and your arms by your sides or at your chest.
3. Lift your chest off the floor, squeezing your back and glutes, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back to the floor.

insert.title: Frog Pump
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out to the sides.
2. Place your arms at your sides and brace your abs.
3. Press your feet together to lift your hips as high as you can, squeezing your glutes and exhaling.
4. Lower slowly and repeat.

insert.title: Seated Single-Leg Extension (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with an ankle cuff on one ankle, attached to a low pulley behind you.
2. Hold the seat and keep your back upright.
3. Extend your knee until your leg is straight, exhaling and squeezing your quad.
4. Lower slowly under control, then finish your reps and switch legs.

insert.title: Mixed-Grip Pull-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with one hand overhand and the other underhand, your arms extended.
2. Brace your abs and pull your shoulders down.
3. Pull your elbows down until your chin clears the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself slowly, and switch your grip on the next set.

insert.title: Board Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a bench with a board of wood held on your chest by a spotter or placed on it, with the barbell above it and your feet planted.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
3. Lower the bar until it touches the board, then pause.
4. Press up as you exhale, driving through the board to lockout.

insert.title: Reverse Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arm on the pad and hold a dumbbell with an overhand grip.
2. Keep your wrist straight and your elbow on the pad.
3. Curl the dumbbell up as high as you can, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly to a nearly straight arm, then switch arms.

insert.title: Pull-Through (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band low behind you, face away and hold the band between your legs with both hands.
2. Step forward to create tension and hinge at the hips with a neutral spine.
3. Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes and exhaling.
4. Hinge back slowly and repeat.

insert.title: Plank Walkout
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall, then fold forward and place your hands on the floor.
2. Walk your hands out until you are in a straight high plank, bracing your abs.
3. Pause, then walk your hands back toward your feet and stand up.

insert.title: Landmine Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest and stand tall.
2. Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
3. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
4. Press through your front foot to return to the start, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Pulldown Dead Bug (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band overhead, lie on your back and hold it with straight arms above your chest, with your knees raised at 90 degrees.
2. Brace your abs and press your lower back into the floor.
3. Pull the band down toward your hips as you lower one leg and extend it, then alternate sides with control.

insert.title: Suspension Chest Press
insert.instructions:
1. Hold the suspension handles at chest height, lean forward at an angle with your body straight.
2. Brace your abs and keep your elbows slightly out.
3. Lower your chest between the handles with control.
4. Press up as you exhale until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Hack Squat (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and stand with your back to it, with your feet slightly forward.
2. Unrack the bar behind your thighs or shoulders and brace your abs.
3. Bend your knees and lower down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Single-Arm Decline Chest Fly (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a pulley high, lie on a decline bench to one side of it and hold the handle with your arm open and slightly bent.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso still.
3. Sweep your hand down and across to the middle of your lower chest, exhaling.
4. Return slowly to the stretch, then switch sides.

insert.title: Good Morning (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a band with your feet shoulder-width apart and loop it across your upper back.
2. Brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing them back until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall as you exhale.

insert.title: Reverse-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a bench and grip the bar with your palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
2. Retract your shoulder blades, plant your feet and unrack the bar.
3. Lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows close to your body.
4. Press up as you exhale until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Bent Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder and stand with your feet wider than hips, eyes on the bell.
2. Bend your torso sideways and push your hips out to the weighted side while pressing the bell up.
3. Keep your arm vertical as you slide under it until the arm is locked overhead.
4. Reverse the movement with control, returning the bell to your shoulder. Switch sides after your reps.

insert.title: Shrimp Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on one leg and hold your other foot behind you with your hand.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Lower slowly until your back knee lightly touches the floor.
4. Press through your standing foot to rise, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Double-Under (Jump Rope)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a jump rope with the handles at hip height and stand with your feet together.
2. Jump a little higher than normal and spin the rope fast using your wrists so it passes under your feet twice per jump.
3. Stay tall, land softly on the balls of your feet and keep a steady rhythm for the time or reps.

insert.title: Bent-Over Scapular Row (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hinge forward with a flat back and hold dumbbells with straight arms.
2. Keep your elbows straight and neck neutral.
3. Pull your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
4. Release slowly to the start.

insert.title: L-Sit Pull-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and lift your straight legs in front of you to form an L.
2. Keep your legs raised and your core tight throughout.
3. Pull your elbows down until your chin clears the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself slowly until your arms are extended while holding your legs up.

insert.title: Box Squat (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Place a box behind you at a height where your thighs end up parallel, and hold a kettlebell at your chest by the horns.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and brace your abs.
3. Sit back and down until you lightly touch the box, keeping your chest up.
4. Press through your feet to stand, exhaling at the top.

insert.title: Suitcase Hold (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Pick up a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep your shoulders level without leaning toward the weight.
3. Hold the position while breathing steadily, then switch hands.

insert.title: Kneeling Crunch (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band overhead and kneel facing it, holding the band beside your head with both hands.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you crunch your ribs toward your pelvis, keeping your hips still.
3. Inhale and return slowly to the upright position against the band's pull.

insert.title: Seated Row (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit with your legs extended and loop a band around your feet, holding the ends.
2. Sit tall with your back straight.
3. Pull your hands to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
4. Return slowly to the start.

insert.title: Goblet Wall Sit (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell at your chest and lean your back flat against a wall.
2. Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees are over your ankles.
3. Press your back into the wall and breathe steadily.
4. Hold for the target time, then slide back up.

insert.title: Banded Bench Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Loop bands over the ends of a barbell and anchor them to the base of the rack, then lie on the bench with the bar over your chest.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and plant your feet.
3. Lower the bar to your mid-chest with control, fighting the band's pull.
4. Press up as you exhale, driving through the band's tension to lockout.

insert.title: Supported Bulgarian Split Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing away from a bench and rest the top of one foot on it, holding a wall or rail for balance.
2. Step the front foot far enough forward that your knee stays over your ankle as you descend.
3. Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel, torso tall.
4. Press through the front heel to stand and exhale. Complete your reps, then switch legs.

insert.title: Kneeling Rollout (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel facing the anchor and hold the suspension handles with your arms straight beneath your shoulders.
2. Brace your abs and keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
3. Roll your hands forward as far as you can control, then pull back to the start, exhaling on the way back.

insert.title: Paused Sumo Deadlift (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with a wide stance, toes out, and the bar over your midfoot, then hinge to grip the bar inside your legs.
2. Tighten your lats, brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Drive your feet apart and pull the bar to just below the knee, then pause for a second.
4. Continue to lockout as you exhale, then lower under control.

insert.title: Twisting Crunch (Plate)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and hold a weight plate against your chest.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl up while twisting one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
3. Inhale and lower back down slowly, then alternate sides.

insert.title: Assisted Sit-Up (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the machine with your feet anchored and set the assistance weight, then hold the handles at your chest.
2. Exhale and curl your torso up toward your knees, leading with your chest and bracing your abs.
3. Inhale and lower back down slowly, keeping your head and neck relaxed.

insert.title: Decline Plank Shoulder Tap
insert.instructions:
1. Get into a plank with your feet on a bench and your hands under your shoulders, body in one straight line.
2. Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes, then lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
3. Return the hand to the floor and tap with the other side, keeping your hips from rocking.

insert.title: Sumo Deadlift (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the Smith bar low, stand with a wide stance and grip the bar inside your legs.
2. Hinge, brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Drive through your feet to stand tall, exhaling.
4. Lower the bar under control.

insert.title: Incline Chest Press (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band behind and below you, sit on an incline bench, and hold the ends at your chest.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Press the band up and forward until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly to your chest.

insert.title: One-Arm Plank
insert.instructions:
1. Set up in a high plank with your feet slightly wider than hip-width.
2. Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes, then lift one hand off the floor and hold it behind you or by your side.
3. Keep your hips level and breathe steadily, then switch arms halfway through the hold.

insert.title: Heel Tap Step-Down
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a step or box with one foot on it and the other leg hanging off the side.
2. Keep your hips level and brace your abs.
3. Bend your standing knee to lower your free heel to the floor.
4. Press through your standing foot to rise without pushing off the floor, then switch legs.

insert.title: GHD Crunch (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set up on the glute-ham developer with your feet anchored and your hips on the pad, leaning back with your arms crossed.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your torso up, rounding your upper back toward your pelvis.
3. Inhale and lower back slowly to a comfortable stretch without arching hard.

insert.title: Ring Front Lever (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from rings with an overhand grip and pull your shoulders down.
2. Raise your body until your torso and legs are horizontal, facing up, with your arms straight.
3. Squeeze your lats and glutes to keep your body in one straight line and breathe steadily.
4. Hold for the target time, then lower under control.

insert.title: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side with your top leg bent and its foot on the floor in front of you.
2. Keep your bottom leg straight and brace your abs.
3. Lift your bottom leg toward the ceiling, pause, then lower slowly, and finish all reps before switching sides.

insert.title: Lying Leg Curl (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie face down on a bench with your knees just off the end and pinch a dumbbell between your feet.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips pressed into the bench.
3. Curl your heels toward your glutes, exhaling as you go.
4. Lower the dumbbell slowly until your legs are almost straight.

insert.title: V-Sit Hold
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor and lean back slightly, then lift your straight legs so your body forms a V.
2. Reach your arms forward alongside your legs and keep your chest tall.
3. Hold the position with your abs braced and breathe steadily.

insert.title: Single-Arm Chest-Supported Y Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand, arm hanging.
2. Keep your neck neutral.
3. Raise your arm up and out in a Y shape, thumb up.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

insert.title: Bent-Over Y Raise (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hinge forward with a flat back and hold light dumbbells hanging below your chest.
2. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
3. Raise your arms up and out in a Y shape, thumbs up.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Planche Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Start in a plank with your hands by your waist, fingers turned out, and shoulders far forward over your hands.
2. Lean forward and tighten your abs, glutes, and legs.
3. Lower your chest toward the floor while keeping your body in one straight line.
4. Press back up to full arm extension.

insert.title: Bent-Knee Inverted Row
insert.instructions:
1. Lie under a fixed bar or rings and hold it with an overhand grip, knees bent and feet flat.
2. Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
3. Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Pullover (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your chest with your arms nearly straight.
2. Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
3. Take a breath and lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel your lats stretch.
4. Pull the bar back over your chest, exhaling.

insert.title: Floor Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on the floor with a kettlebell in each hand, held with the bells resting against your forearms, knees bent.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Lower your upper arms until your elbows touch the floor, then pause.
4. Press the kettlebells back up as you exhale.

insert.title: Straight-Leg Sit-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your legs straight and your feet anchored or held down, arms crossed on your chest.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your torso up to sitting.
3. Inhale and lower back down slowly under control.

insert.title: Rollout (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel with a loaded barbell on the floor in front of you and grip it shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep a straight line from your head to your knees as you roll the bar forward.
3. Go as far as you can with a flat back, then pull the bar back to the start, exhaling on the way.

insert.title: Standing Hip Abduction (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Loop a band around your ankles or just above your knees and stand tall, holding a support lightly.
2. Brace your abs and shift your weight onto the standing leg.
3. Press your working leg out to the side against the band without leaning, then lower slowly and repeat before switching.

insert.title: Single-Arm Jerk (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder and stand with feet hip-width apart.
2. Dip slightly at the knees, keeping your torso upright.
3. Drive up explosively and press the bell overhead, dipping again to lock out.
4. Stand fully, lower the bell to your shoulder with control, and switch sides after your reps.

insert.title: Weighted Suspension Inverted Row
insert.instructions:
1. Wear a weight vest or place a plate on your lap, then hold the suspension handles and lean back.
2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
3. Pull your chest up to your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Bent-Over Row (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hinge forward with a flat back and hold a kettlebell in each hand, arms hanging.
2. Brace your abs.
3. Row the bells to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Mountain Climber (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Place your feet in the suspension straps and set up in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs at a steady pace while breathing rhythmically.

insert.title: Single-Arm Overhead Squat (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and lock it out, keeping your ribs down.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and brace your abs.
3. Sit down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping the kettlebell over your mid-foot.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling, then switch arms.

insert.title: Single-Arm Seated Chest Press (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set one pulley at chest height, sit on a bench facing away from it and hold the handle at your chest.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso square.
3. Press the handle forward until your arm is almost straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly under control, then switch sides.

insert.title: Step-Up (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on a bench or box with a band looped under your front foot and held at your sides, or anchored under the box.
2. Plant your whole front foot on the box and brace your abs.
3. Drive through the front heel to stand tall, keeping tension in the band.
4. Lower back down slowly with control, tap lightly, and repeat; switch legs after your reps.

insert.title: Standing Hip Abduction
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall next to a wall or support and hold it lightly for balance.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
3. Lift your outside leg out to the side without leaning, then lower slowly, and finish all reps before switching legs.

insert.title: Standing Hip Extension (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band low and loop it around one ankle, then stand tall facing the anchor with a light hold on a support.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
3. Press your leg straight back against the band, squeezing your glute and exhaling.
4. Return slowly, then switch legs.

insert.title: Single-Leg Stride Jump
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on one leg with a slight bend in your knee.
2. Swing your arms and jump forward, driving your free knee up.
3. Land softly on the same foot and hold your balance.
4. Pause, reset and repeat, then switch legs.

insert.title: Side-Lying Shoulder External Rotation (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side holding a light dumbbell in your top hand with your elbow tucked against your ribs.
2. Bend your elbow to a right angle with your forearm across your belly.
3. Rotate your forearm upward, keeping your elbow pinned to your side.
4. Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Lateral Step-Up (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand beside a box, with the nearest foot on it.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Press through the lead foot to stand tall on the box, exhaling.
4. Lower your free foot slowly to the floor, finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Forearm Pronation (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your forearm on your thigh, hand over your knee, holding a dumbbell by one end with your palm facing in.
2. Keep your elbow still and your forearm fixed.
3. Rotate the dumbbell until your palm faces down.
4. Rotate back slowly, then switch arms.

insert.title: Knee Tuck (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Place your feet in the suspension straps and set up in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you pull your knees toward your chest.
3. Inhale and slowly extend your legs back to the plank without letting your hips sag.

insert.title: Weighted Bar Muscle-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Attach a weight plate to a belt or hold it between your feet, then hang from a bar with an overhand grip.
2. Pull explosively, leaning back, and bring the bar toward your lower chest.
3. Rotate your elbows over the bar and press up until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself slowly back to a hang.

insert.title: Cossack Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet wide, toes slightly turned out.
2. Shift your weight to one side and sit into that leg while the other leg stays straight.
3. Keep your chest up and your heel down, lowering as far as your mobility allows.
4. Press through your bent leg to return to the center, then switch sides.

insert.title: Curtsy Lunge
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at your chest.
2. Step one leg back and across behind the other, as in a curtsy.
3. Lower until your front thigh is near parallel, keeping your chest up.
4. Press through your front foot to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Assisted Inverse Leg Curl (Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the machine so your hands grip the handles and your body hangs as the pad assists you, legs extended.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips tucked.
3. Bend at the knees and bring your heels toward you as your hips lift, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly under control.

insert.title: Pin Bench Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the safety pins in a rack at a chosen height and lie on the bench with the bar resting on the pins over your chest.
2. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and retract your shoulder blades.
3. Press the bar from the pins to lockout, exhaling.
4. Lower it back to the pins and let it rest before the next rep.

insert.title: Ring Archer Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Set gymnastic rings low and get into a push-up position with your hands in them, body straight.
2. Brace your abs and keep the rings steady.
3. Shift toward one hand and lower your chest to it, keeping the other arm straight.
4. Press up as you exhale, then switch sides.

insert.title: Overhead Lunge (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Press a barbell overhead with a wide grip, keeping your arms locked and ribs down.
2. Step forward and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
3. Keep the bar over your mid-foot and your core braced.
4. Push through your front foot to return to the start, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Oblique Rollout (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold the suspension handles with your arms straight beneath your shoulders, either kneeling or on your toes.
2. Brace your abs and roll your hands forward while sliding them slightly to one side.
3. Pull back to the start, exhaling as you return, and alternate sides.

insert.title: Side Plank Rotation
insert.instructions:
1. Set up in a side plank on your forearm or hand with your top arm reaching up.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you rotate your torso and thread the top arm under your body.
3. Unwind back to the start and open your chest to the ceiling, repeating before switching sides.

insert.title: Zercher Squat (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on the Smith rails at elbow height and hook it in the crooks of your elbows, hands clasped.
2. Unrack, step back slightly, and set your feet shoulder-width apart with your chest up.
3. Brace and squat down until your thighs are about parallel, keeping the bar close to your torso.
4. Drive through your heels to stand and exhale at the top.

insert.title: Single-Leg Deadlift (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in the hand opposite the standing leg, with a slight bend in your knee.
2. Keep your hips square and your back flat.
3. Hinge forward at the hip as your free leg extends behind you, lowering the kettlebell toward the floor.
4. Squeeze your glute to return upright, then repeat before switching sides.

insert.title: Seesaw Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and press one bell overhead.
3. As you lower that bell, press the other one up.
4. Alternate smoothly like a seesaw, keeping your torso still.

insert.title: Crossover Step-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Stand beside a box or bench, with your feet hip-width apart, and place the foot nearest the box on it.
2. Cross your trailing foot in front and over your lead leg as you press up.
3. Stand tall on top, then lower the trailing foot slowly to the floor.
4. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Plank (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Place your forearms in the suspension handles or your feet in the straps and set up in a plank.
2. Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body forms one straight line.
3. Hold the position, keeping your neck neutral and breathing steadily.

insert.title: Side-Lying Hip Abduction (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side with a band looped around your thighs or ankles and your legs straight.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips stacked.
3. Raise your top leg up and slightly back against the band, then lower slowly under control.

insert.title: Glute Bridge with Hip Abduction (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with a band looped just above your knees, knees bent and feet flat.
2. Press your knees out against the band and brace your abs.
3. Lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders, exhaling.
4. Keep pressing out, then lower slowly.

insert.title: Chest-Supported Incline Row (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a kettlebell in each hand, arms hanging.
2. Keep your neck neutral.
3. Row the bells toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Z Press (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you and a barbell at shoulder height.
2. Brace your abs and keep your back tall without leaning back.
3. Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.

insert.title: Single-Leg Deadlift (Smith Machine)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand inside the Smith machine on one leg, holding the bar with both hands at thigh height, with a soft bend in your knee.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Hinge forward at the hip, sliding the bar down your shin as your free leg extends behind you.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then finish your reps and switch legs.

insert.title: Suspension Scapular Row
insert.instructions:
1. Hold the suspension handles with straight arms and lean back.
2. Keep your body in a straight line.
3. Pull your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
4. Release slowly to the start.

insert.title: Z Press (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you, holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
2. Brace your abs and keep your back tall without leaning back.
3. Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight, exhaling.
4. Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.

insert.title: Kneeling Hip Abduction (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and get on all fours with the strap on your working leg.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Exhale as you lift your knee out to the side, then lower slowly against the cable and finish all reps before switching legs.

insert.title: Single-Arm Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie back on an incline bench with one dumbbell above your upper chest, palm facing in, elbow slightly bent.
2. Brace your abs and keep your torso from twisting.
3. Open your arm out to the side until you feel a stretch across your chest.
4. Bring it back up as you exhale, then switch arms.

insert.title: Single-Arm Deadlift (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell on the floor beside one foot.
2. Hinge at the hips, grip the dumbbell with one hand and keep your back flat.
3. Drive through your feet to stand tall without tilting your torso, exhaling.
4. Lower the dumbbell to the floor by pushing your hips back, then switch arms.

insert.title: Kneeling Glute Kickback (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel on all fours with a band looped around one foot and held under your hands.
2. Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
3. Kick your heel up toward the ceiling, exhaling.
4. Return slowly, then switch legs.

insert.title: Standing Calf Raise (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side, with the balls of both feet planted and your free hand on a wall for balance.
2. Brace your abs and keep your knee straight.
3. Press through the ball of your foot to rise as high as you can, then pause at the top.
4. Lower slowly until your heel sinks just below level, breathing out as you rise.

insert.title: Close-Stance Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet close together and your arms in front of you.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Decline Crunch (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and hold a cable rope or handle at your chest or behind your head.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you curl your ribs toward your pelvis, keeping your lower back on the pad.
3. Pause at the top, then inhale and lower slowly until you feel a stretch in your abs.

insert.title: Step-Up (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
2. Place one whole foot on the box and take a breath to brace.
3. Press through that heel to stand tall without pushing off the back foot.
4. Lower slowly back to the floor, then repeat. Switch legs after your reps.

insert.title: Hip Thrust (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, a band across your hips with its ends anchored under your feet.
2. Plant your feet flat, knees bent.
3. Drive your hips up until your torso is level, squeezing your glutes and exhaling.
4. Lower slowly and repeat.

insert.title: Oblique V-Up (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side holding a dumbbell at your chest, with your legs straight.
2. Brace your abs and exhale as you lift your torso and legs up toward each other.
3. Lower back slowly, finish all reps on one side, then switch.

insert.title: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand in a split stance with your front foot on a low plate or step.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Sumo Deadlift (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand with a wide stance, toes out, holding one dumbbell between your legs with both hands.
2. Hinge, brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Drive through your feet to stand tall, exhaling.
4. Lower the dumbbell under control.

insert.title: Wide-Grip Chin-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with an underhand grip, wider than shoulder width, and your arms extended.
2. Brace your abs and pull your shoulders down.
3. Pull your elbows down until your chin clears the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

insert.title: Good Morning (Safety Bar)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a safety squat bar on your shoulders and step back with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep a neutral spine.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing them back until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
4. Drive your hips forward to stand tall as you exhale.

insert.title: Paused Front Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Rest the bar on your front shoulders with your elbows forward and unrack it.
2. Brace your abs and sit down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Hold the bottom for about two seconds while keeping your chest up.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Double Jerk (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders and stand with feet hip-width apart.
2. Dip slightly at the knees, keeping your torso upright.
3. Drive up explosively and press the bells overhead as you dip a second time to lock out.
4. Stand fully, then lower the bells to your shoulders with control and reset.

insert.title: Front Hold (Plate)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a weight plate at chest height with both hands, elbows tucked in.
2. Stand tall with shoulders back, abs braced, and feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Hold this position for the target time, breathing steadily.
4. Lower the plate carefully when time is up.

insert.title: Lateral Lunge (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing a suspension anchor, holding the handles with your arms extended for balance.
2. Step out wide to one side, push your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
3. Keep your chest up and your lunging foot flat.
4. Push off the bent leg to return to the center, exhaling, then switch sides.

insert.title: Staggered-Stance Hip Thrust (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit with your upper back against a bench and a barbell padded across your hips, one foot slightly ahead of the other.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Drive through the front foot until your torso is level, squeezing your glutes and exhaling.
4. Lower slowly, then switch feet.

insert.title: Half-Kneeling Low-to-High Chop (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the cable low and kneel on the knee farthest from the stack, holding the handle with both hands beside your hip.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips square.
3. Exhale and pull the handle diagonally up across your body to above the opposite shoulder, then lower back slowly under control.

insert.title: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on your upper back and stand in a split stance with your front foot on a low plate or step.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Lateral Step-Up (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the bar on your upper back and stand beside a box, with the nearest foot on it.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Press through the lead foot to stand tall on the box, exhaling.
4. Lower your free foot slowly to the floor, finish your reps, then switch sides.

insert.title: Long-Lever Plank
insert.instructions:
1. Set up in a forearm plank, then walk your elbows forward past your shoulders.
2. Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body stays in one straight line.
3. Hold the position while breathing steadily, and stop if your lower back sags.

insert.title: Lying Windshield Wiper
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your arms out wide and your legs raised straight above your hips.
2. Brace your abs and lower both legs to one side as far as you can control, keeping your shoulders on the floor.
3. Exhale as you lift them back to center, then lower to the other side.

insert.title: Bulgarian Split Squat (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a kettlebell at your chest or one in each hand, and rest the top of one foot on a bench behind you.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down by bending your front knee until your thigh is near parallel.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Kipping Handstand Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Kick up into a handstand against a wall with hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Lower your head to the floor under control with your abs braced.
3. Drive explosively through the hands and use a small leg kick to help press up.
4. Finish with arms locked and body straight, then reset for the next rep.

insert.title: Glute Bridge Walkout
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your heels planted, then lift into a glute bridge.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips high.
3. Walk your feet out slowly while holding the bridge.
4. Walk them back in and lower slowly.

insert.title: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
insert.instructions:
1. Stand in a split stance with your front foot on a low plate or step and your back foot behind you.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Single-Arm Suspension Bicep Curl
insert.instructions:
1. Hold one suspension handle with an underhand grip and lean back with your arm straight and your feet planted.
2. Keep your body in a straight line and brace your abs.
3. Exhale as you curl your hand toward your head by bending your elbow, then lower slowly, and finish all reps before switching arms.

insert.title: Incline Bench Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set an incline bench and lie back with a kettlebell in each hand, held with the bells resting against your forearms.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and plant your feet.
3. Lower the kettlebells toward your upper chest with control.
4. Press them back up as you exhale.

insert.title: Suitcase Carry (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Load a barbell and pick it up with a grip in the center in one hand, standing tall.
2. Brace your abs and keep your shoulders level and your torso upright without leaning.
3. Walk the set distance with short, controlled steps, then set the bar down and switch hands.

insert.title: Step-Up (Cable)
insert.instructions:
1. Set a low pulley with a belt or handles and stand facing away from it, one foot on a step.
2. Keep your chest up and brace your abs.
3. Press through your heel to step up, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly back down and switch legs after your set.

insert.title: Single-Arm Pull-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with one hand, with your other arm held to your side, and your core tight.
2. Pull your shoulder down and drive your elbow toward your ribs.
3. Pull until your chin clears the bar, exhaling.
4. Lower yourself slowly until your arm is fully extended, then switch arms.

insert.title: Band-Assisted Push-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band at a sturdy point at about chest height and loop it around your back and under your arms.
2. Get into a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders and your body straight.
3. Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
4. Press up as you exhale, letting the band help you through the hardest part.

insert.title: Kneeling Hip Thrust (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Kneel upright with a band anchored low behind you and looped around your hips.
2. Keep your torso tall and brace your abs.
3. Hinge back slightly, then drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes and exhaling.
4. Return slowly and repeat.

insert.title: Lateral Shuttle
insert.instructions:
1. Mark two points about five meters apart and stand at one with a low athletic stance.
2. Shuffle sideways to the other point without crossing your feet.
3. Touch the line, then shuffle back, keeping your hips low.
4. Repeat at a hard pace for the target time or distance, then stand and recover.

insert.title: Bench Press (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench with a kettlebell in each hand, held with the bells resting against your forearms, and your feet planted.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and brace your abs.
3. Lower the kettlebells until your elbows are just below the bench, keeping the bells stable.
4. Press them back up as you exhale.

insert.title: Bulgarian Split Squat (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of a band a stride in front of a bench, with the ends over your shoulders, and rest the top of one foot on the bench.
2. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
3. Lower straight down by bending your front knee until your thigh is near parallel.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Reverse Lunge (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a kettlebell at your chest or one in each hand and stand tall.
2. Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
3. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
4. Press through your front foot to return to the start, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Incline Y Raise (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a band low, lie chest-down on an incline bench, and hold the band ends with straight arms.
2. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
3. Raise your arms up and out in a Y shape against the band.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Bulgarian Split Squat (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Face away from a suspension anchor and rest the top of one foot in a strap behind you.
2. Hold your arms in front for balance and keep your chest up.
3. Lower straight down by bending your front knee until your thigh is near parallel.
4. Press through your front heel to stand, exhaling, then switch legs.

insert.title: Paused Squat (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and sit down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Hold the bottom for about two seconds while keeping your chest up.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Single-Arm Suspension Chest Press
insert.instructions:
1. Hold one suspension handle at your chest, lean forward at an angle with your free hand behind your back, body straight.
2. Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
3. Press your body away from the handle until your arm is almost straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly to the start, then switch sides.

insert.title: Straight-Leg Donkey Kick
insert.instructions:
1. Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
2. Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
3. Kick one leg straight back and up until it is level with your hips, exhaling.
4. Lower slowly without arching, then switch legs.

insert.title: Pin Front Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Set the safety pins at the bottom of your squat depth and rest the bar on your front shoulders.
2. Brace your abs and sit down until the bar touches the pins, then pause.
3. Reset your brace without relaxing your back.
4. Drive through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Bent-Knee Side Plank
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your side with your knees bent and your elbow directly under your shoulder.
2. Press your forearm into the floor and lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line.
3. Hold the position, bracing your abs and breathing steadily, then lower with control and switch sides.

insert.title: Landmine Squat (Barbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
3. Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling.

insert.title: Incline Bicep Curl (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Sit back on an incline bench holding a kettlebell by the handle in each hand, with your arms hanging down.
2. Keep your upper arms still and exhale as you curl the weights toward your shoulders.
3. Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

insert.title: Incline Skullcrusher (Kettlebell)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on an incline bench holding a kettlebell by the horns with straight arms above your chest.
2. Keep your upper arms still.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the bell behind your head.
4. Extend your arms back up, exhaling.

insert.title: Straddle L-Sit (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Grip the suspension handles and press down to lift your body off the floor with your arms locked and shoulders pulled down.
2. Raise your straight legs out in a wide straddle until they are near hip height.
3. Hold the position with your abs tight and breathe steadily, then lower with control.

insert.title: Standing Calf Raise (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Hold the suspension handles and stand tall with your feet together and your arms straight, taking only light support.
2. Keep your body in one line and your knees straight.
3. Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can and squeeze your calves.
4. Lower under control until your heels dip slightly, exhaling on the way up.

insert.title: Standing Rollout (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Stand facing the anchor and hold the suspension handles with your body leaning forward on straight arms.
2. Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes to keep a straight line.
3. Lower your body forward by extending your arms overhead, then pull back to the start, exhaling on the way.

insert.title: Single-Arm Overhead Squat (Dumbbell)
insert.instructions:
1. Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and lock it out, keeping your ribs down.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and brace your abs.
3. Sit down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping the dumbbell over your mid-foot.
4. Press through your heels to stand, exhaling, then switch arms.

insert.title: Straight-Arm Pulldown (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Anchor a resistance band overhead and stand facing it, holding the ends with straight arms.
2. Hinge slightly at the hips and brace your abs.
3. Sweep your arms down to your thighs, keeping your elbows nearly straight, exhaling.
4. Return slowly until your arms are overhead and you feel a lat stretch.

insert.title: Uneven Pull-Up
insert.instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with one hand on the bar and the other on a towel, strap, or lower grip, with your arms extended.
2. Brace your abs and pull your shoulders down.
3. Pull your elbows down until your chin clears the bar, exhaling, shifting more effort to the higher hand.
4. Lower yourself slowly, then swap hand positions on the next set.

insert.title: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (Band)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with a band across your hips and its ends anchored under your hands, one foot planted and the other leg extended.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Press through your heel to lift your hips until your body is straight, exhaling.
4. Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower slowly and switch legs.

insert.title: Suspension Y Raise
insert.instructions:
1. Hold the suspension handles with straight arms and lean back.
2. Keep your body in a straight line.
3. Raise your arms up and out in a Y shape.
4. Lower slowly to the start.

insert.title: Hamstring Curl (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your heels in the suspension straps and your arms flat at your sides.
2. Lift your hips into a bridge and brace your abs.
3. Bend your knees to pull your heels toward you, keeping your hips high, exhaling.
4. Straighten slowly and repeat.

insert.title: Staggered-Stance Glute Bridge
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with both knees bent, one foot a step ahead of the other and your arms at your sides.
2. Brace your abs and tuck your ribs.
3. Press through the front foot and lift your hips, exhaling.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly and switch feet.

insert.title: Single-Leg Hamstring Curl (Suspension)
insert.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with one heel in a suspension strap handle and your other leg lifted or bent.
2. Press your hips up into a bridge and keep them level.
3. Curl your heel toward your glute, exhaling as you pull.
4. Extend your leg back slowly without dropping your hips, then switch legs.
